info.name: Create a new single or multi party instant message conversation between the caller and specified users.

items.docs:
At least one user ID must be provided or
an error response will be sent.

The caller is implicitly included in the members of the
created chat.

Duplicate users will be included in the membership of the chat but
the duplication will be silently ignored.

If there is an existing IM conversation with the same set of participants then
the id of that existing stream will be returned.

version 1.0 of this specification but now expects

info.name: Get attachments in a particular stream.

params.name: sid
params.description: Stream Id

params.name: since
params.description:
Timestamp of first required attachment.
This is a long integer value representing milliseconds since Jan 1 1970

params.name: to
params.description:
Timestamp of last required attachment.
This is a long integer value representing milliseconds since Jan 1 1970

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of attachments to return. Default is 50. Must be a positive integer and must not exceed 100.

params.name: sortDir
params.description: Attachment date sort direction : ASC or DESC (default to ASC)

items.docs: Get attachments in a particular stream.
